news.title: Newsom announces $46 million of voter-approved funding to help address pollution
news.summary: Gov. Gavin Newsom announced Thursday he is deploying $46 million in voter-approved funding to help clean up the Tijuana River at the California-Mexico border, one of the nation's worst and longest-running environmental crises
